Pro Docs - Shadcn Studio Figma Plugin - Shadcn Studio

name: Shadcn Studio Figma Plugin
summary: Figma plugin that generates React + shadcn/ui code from design frames, with token sync, blocks and CLI output.
description: An AI design-to-code plugin for the shadcn/ui ecosystem: select a Figma frame and it generates React components using shadcn components and Tailwind CSS, in Radix UI (default) or Base UI style. It supports copy-paste code or a shadcn CLI install command, imports and exports shadcn create presets, syncs Figma variables with CSS variables, and can drag 1000+ blocks, 9 dashboards and 6+ landing pages into Figma. AI runs on your own API keys (Claude, Gemini or OpenAI); a plugin license key is required.
contains: AI code generation from Figma frames using Claude, GPT or Gemini models (BYOK — your own API keys)
outputs React + shadcn components with Tailwind CSS v4, desktop and mobile variants
Radix UI (default) or Base UI output toggle
copy generated code or a shadcn CLI command (npx shadcn add …)
import/export shadcn create presets and Figma ↔ CSS variables
drag & drop 1000+ blocks, 9 dashboards and 6+ landing pages
reported accuracy: 90–95% simple components, 70–80% complex layouts
